auth.name: Listen. Notice. Speak.
auth.copy: Build listening confidence with structured lessons, dictation, shadowing, vocabulary, grammar, and TOEIC practice.
auth.note: Authentication uses Keycloak Authorization Code + PKCE. Your learning history and preferences stay attached to your account.

home.title: Keep your English moving.
home.weakCopy: You missed this pattern in recent grammar practice.

lesson.ipaCopy: IPA is an optional, accent-aware annotation. In production it is loaded from cached/on-demand lesson data according to admin policy and learner preference.
lesson.contextRule: These notes are contextual support. They are not Vocabulary Practice or Grammar Practice unless this Lesson explicitly includes those activities.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.lead: Analytics is a projection. Lesson, TOEIC, Vocabulary and Curriculum remain the owners of their detailed progress and attempt history.

settings.title: Learning settings
settings.lead: Persistent learning preferences sync across devices. Language, theme, temporary playback speed, expanded notes and other device/session choices stay local.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load preferences. Local defaults are shown.
settings.localPreferenceNote: Language and appearance are device preferences; learning preferences continue to sync with your Lyreo account.
